note: Validated examples, not a complete inventory. Check the installed release; candidate-only classes may not exist in alpha.4.

components.name: Button
components.notes: Use button for actions and a for navigation. ARIA states describe real application state.

components.name: Panel
components.notes: Choose native headings and accessible labels.

components.name: Form fields
components.notes: Real handlers and field validation belong to the application.

components.name: Form compositions
components.notes: Unreleased alpha.5 candidate only. Native form behavior, associated labels, server validation; use syn-region for container-responsive rows. The Radix adapter is separately optional.

components.name: Tables
components.notes: Use proper headers, captions and scroll containers.

components.name: Stats
components.notes: Named container must be an ancestor of responsive children.

components.name: Navigation
components.notes: Real links and aria-current only for the actual current page.

components.name: Application shell
components.notes: Load optional recipes CSS after core.

components.name: Marketing hero
components.notes: Load optional recipes CSS after core.

components.name: Charts
components.notes: Only styling hooks. Generate chart values and SVG geometry yourself.

components.name: Heatmap
components.notes: Supply textual cell labels, data-syn-level and real data.

components.name: Advanced geometry frames
components.notes: Load optional geometry CSS. One shape per frame; accent emphasis is additive. Refer to visual-intensity.md for pseudo-element ownership and backgrounds.

components.name: Decorative effects
components.notes: Optional CSS only. data-syn-intensity on .syn-root or nested regions selects quiet, standard or cinematic effects without changing semantic state.

components.name: CRM compositions
components.notes: Unreleased alpha.5, CSS-only optional layouts. Use a GET form, labelled stages, focusable board overflow and definition-list details; application implements filtering and pipeline state.

components.name: Collaboration and agent operations
components.notes: Unreleased optional MIT CSS module. Read-only styling only; the application supplies actual messages, role/status, file access, actions and approvals.
